[[Kurzick Ranger]]s are found during a number of Luxon quests and missions in the Jade Sea when you are fighting against Kurzick forces. They are also found protecting the inside and outside of Fort Aspenwood. Inside, they are situated above the stairs that lead up from the green gate and defend the central path to the green gate. One is also found between the inner and outer orange gates. The rangers inside do not respawn. Outside, they spawn when Kurzick forces kill a [[Luxon Commander]] and take control of a command point.
